design_brief: Directional lamp useful beside sofa or documents; light glow stays in a separate optional overlay.
gameplay_scope: Approved passive art-library object only; no runtime/default-layout binding, powered-light system, interaction, service action, actor pose, worker authority, persistence or gameplay transaction.

current_availability.direction_art_review: Approved as exact task-floor-lamp-v2 passive art only after native and 4x review. Four independently authored screen-axis views retain one common 128×256 canvas, [64,208] pivot, exact one-cell collision, fixed screen-upper-left light and compact solid floor contact. Export 112/0, final shared structural 412/0 and isolated actual-GameMain 183/0 checks pass; the main-agent rubric is 3/2/3/3/3/3 (2.83). No glow layer, powered state, action, service, runtime binding or default placement is approved.

previous_catalogue_availability.direction_art_review: No finished art or runtime family is claimed for this proposal; unrelated concept/source art may exist.

superseded_v1_art_proposal.reason: The broad dithered floor halo in v1 was visually busy at native room scale. Its files and evidence remain preserved and are not relabeled as approved art.

native_geometry.anchor_rule: One unchanged canvas coordinate represents local floor pivot [0,0] in every direction and every layer. Transparent padding is not sprite scaling.

layers.note: Optional ambient/glow overlay is absent and unclaimed; passive art approval does not create a powered state.
